messages:
maria chen: FYI ran into a weird quota graph issue this morning. admin console showed org X spike with another org's tokens after a canary fallback. support flagged it.
sara klein: can you repro? quick steps?
maria chen: yup. steps: open org-X quota tab -> switch to org-Y -> kick off some bulk embed jobs on Y -> switch back to X and refresh. counts for X sometimes show Y's recent usage for ~20-40s.
leo wang: is this purely a UI caching glitch or do we have backend attribution problems?
maria chen: dug logs: quota-collector enqueued samples with org_id=org-X but payload metadata referenced org-Y. pasted sanitized snippet to the ticket.
ajay singh: we shipped router fallback that uses a pooled "carrier" object to avoid allocations. PR note mentioned reusing carriers and conditionally clearing fields.
sara klein: that sounds risky. link?
ajay singh: https://git.internal/redwood/repo/pulls/5218 (router: affinity fallback + carrier pool). see carrier checkout/return logic around line ~210.
leo wang: hypothesis: carrier pooling + exporter/batcher reading payload by reference -> stale metadata leak across org boundaries.
maria chen: repro log (sanitized):
```
INFO quota-collector: enqueue sample org_id=org-X tokens=98 carrier=pool-7
INFO quota-collector: emit sample org_id=org-X tokens=98 payload.org_hint=org-Y
```
ajay singh: matches pooling leak. fallback path rewrites some headers but doesn't always rebind all carrier fields before enqueueing.
ops-oncall: deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-21T08:12 -> router-service v2.4.1 canary@10% (sha: abcd1234)
deploy-bot: recommend rollback? :warning:
sara klein: quick mitigation options: 1) hotfix quota-collector to deep-clone payload before enqueuing, 2) change carrier.reset() to clear payload fully, 3) UI-side TTL/mark unverified for recent samples.
leo wang: fastest low-risk: copy payload at enqueue in quota-collector. small patch and tests. longer term: remove pooled mutable carriers from telemetry path.
ajay singh: I'll open hotfix PR to clone payload on enqueue and add unit test for pooled-carrier leak. will also schedule router revert if hotfix confirms.
maria chen: also adding a small UX tweak: mark quota samples as "pending verification" for 30s after canary roll events to avoid confusing customers.
ops-oncall: created PD alert "quota-attr-mismatch" (P2). added query to flag samples where sample.org_id != sample.payload.org_hint.
ajay singh: hotfix PR: https://git.internal/redwood/repo/pulls/5220 (quota-collector: clone payload before enqueue). pinging @leo @sara for fast review.
leo wang: reviewing now. will also add instrumentation to router to emit carrier pool events (checkout/return) with pool_id so we can correlate.
sara klein: rollout plan: merge hotfix -> canary 10% -> monitor mismatch alert -> promote -> revert carrier pooling in router + add integration tests -> long-term immutable metadata objects.
deploy-bot: deploy request queued: quota-collector v1.12.3-hotfix (sha: deff5678) -> canary 10% -> 2026-03-21T09:02UTC
maria chen: noted affected support ticket #SUP-4821. I've added support notes and a screenshot of the misleading graph.
ops-oncall: keeping PD on watch. will escalate if mismatch rate > 0.1%.
leo wang: after merge i'll run synthetic rapid-org-switch + embed workload to validate.
sara klein: follow-ups: @ajay hotfix + router revert, @leo add router instrumentation + synth test, @maria update support runbook + UI TTL, @ops-oncall monitor alerts.
maria chen: thanks all, appreciate the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:"
